description: If you're a professional detailer or hardcore enthusiast who mixes and dilutes chemicals from gallon jugs, you're going to need some Secondary Container Dilution Bottles. These heavy duty detailing bottles with natural sprayer heads hold and spray 16 ounces of your favorite detailing chemicals. Buy your favorite Chemical Guys cleaner, degreaser, spray wax, spray sealant, or spray able dressing and protectant by the gallon, then pour them into the clear secondary container bottle and get to work! The 16 ounce capacity is the same as all the other quantities sold by Chemical Guys, but you have the freedom to mix your own custom dilution for targeted detailing that saves even more money. We normally recommend diluting cleaners and degreasers 10:1 for tough messes, and 20:1 for lighter messes. Skip the measuring cups and turn the Secondary Container Bottle to the printed dilution ratio chart for easy mixing and blending. Pour your preferred chemical to the desired dilution ratio line printed on the side, then fill to the top with clean, filtered water. The natural sprayer head included with these secondary bottles are the same sprayers that you know and have used with every spray able Chemical Guys product. Chemical Guys Secondary Dilution Bottles come printed with GHS-compliant communication labeling for improved safety in your professional detailing shop or enthusiast garage setting. Easily mark the bottle to communicate the chemical name, and indicate any type of potential hazards and handling precautions for a safer work environment. Easily use your gallons of detailing products and mix your own custom dilution blend for professional detailing results with the Chemical Guys Secondary Container Dilution Bottle.
